convention.axes: right-handed, +Y up, +Z forward. L is source -X. Raw original pivots and translations in Blockbench units; 16 per block.
convention.matrix: parent * T(pivot) * T(p) * Rz * Ry * Rx * T(-pivot), world-rest pivot convention
convention.interpolation: linear per channel; clamp endpoints. loop guard only. Hurt is ADDITIVE as body-space flinch; other clips replace rest.
convention.sampling: Full tick poses are sampled before decimation; degree error <=0.08, position error <=0.15 author units at source key samples.
convention.adapter: gate.mesh.gz already carries the joint names; per-bone meshes identify source names WITHIN the source group. Do not join meshes globally by name.

encounter.existing: ONE four-armed gate figure plus a separate wrist carrier; anchors alternate. L/R are model-space, not guaranteed equal to the world anchor side after yaw. Select sign from dot(anchor-body,actor_local_X_world).
encounter.four_hands: Ipsilateral red orbital palm points first; opposite orbital palm draws protectively across its own socket. Same-side stone arm delivers the blow; opposite stone arm braces outward.
encounter.clock: 20 ticks/s. Use server start tick plus partial tick. Clamp exact terminal slam pose for contact at elapsed=78; transition to lock/recover immediately on authoritative STAMP completion. Interpolate aim before 50 and freeze thereafter.
encounter.contact: Target in source space is [side*128,0,+160]. These ground-contact poses apply to nominal altar anchor only. For a freely targeted decal, clamp the visual endpoint to the reachable zone or solve a constrained wrist IK separately.
encounter.recovery: Correct anchor: slam(side) t78 -> lock(side) t0..120 -> recover(side) t0..40. Miss: go directly from slam t78 to recover scaled to 32 game ticks. Anchor swap: mix the new guard over 8–12 ticks. Do not reset to rest at frame zero of OPEN.
encounter.two_figures_optional: If the encounter uses two bodies, primary uses its own slam; the other remains in its opposite guard, offset 12/80 ticks, and indicates the safe/locked side. Swap roles only on a real server-authored next cast. The companion has no second damaging event.
encounter.hit_overlay: hurt_L/R names the struck side. On a locked wrist mask its shoulder chain and all torso ancestors to preserve the ground contact; apply head/eye-hand/tongue flinch only. Gate_mouth includes both tooth rows; keep its rotation small.
